summary: Board-certified primary care physician with 10 years of continuous full-time experience delivering comprehensive primary care in outpatient and community health settings. Proven record of managing chronic disease panels, preventive care, and multidisciplinary care coordination within a growing mid-market healthcare organization.

experience.title: Physician (Primary Care)
bullets: Manage a panel of approximately 1,800 patients, providing continuity of care across preventive, acute, and chronic conditions in an outpatient clinic setting.
Order, perform, and interpret diagnostic tests and imaging, using results alongside patient history to diagnose conditions and adjust treatment plans.
Prescribe medications, vaccinations, and specialized therapies, monitoring patient response and reevaluating treatments at follow-up visits.
Counsel patients on diet, activity, hygiene, and disease prevention, contributing to a 22% increase in completed preventive screenings over two years.
Direct and coordinate care activities of nurses, medical assistants, and advanced practice providers, including supervising clinical workflows and precepting trainees.

experience.title: Primary Care Physician
bullets: Delivered full-spectrum primary care to a diverse patient population, documenting medical histories, examination findings, and treatment plans in the electronic health record.
Diagnosed and managed chronic conditions such as diabetes, hypertension, and asthma, monitoring progress and escalating care when clinically indicated.
Explained procedures, test results, and prescribed treatments to patients and caregivers, improving patient understanding and adherence.
Referred patients to medical specialists and coordinated follow-up care, reducing avoidable emergency department visits among high-risk patients by an estimated 15%.
Collaborated with nursing and ancillary staff to standardize vaccination and chronic care workflows across two clinic sites.

experience.title: Primary Care Physician
bullets: Provided outpatient evaluation and treatment for acute and chronic illnesses, ordering and interpreting laboratory and diagnostic studies.
Maintained accurate, timely patient records including medical history, reports, and examination results.
Advised patients and community members on preventive care, hygiene, and lifestyle modification during individual visits and group education sessions.
Participated in on-call coverage and coordinated with specialists to ensure continuity for patients requiring referral.
Supervised medical students and residents during clinical rotations, reviewing treatment plans and documentation.

education.institution: a state university school of medicine
